diagnosis_this_revision_responds_to.observability_consequence: The policy no longer has to integrate angular rate over time to infer heading, removing the observability gap that motivated recurrence.
diagnosis_this_revision_responds_to.test: Measure whether memoryless PPO matches or exceeds the recurrent result under the changed observation premise.

not_authorized: This revision does not claim recurrence was wrong under the earlier observation contract. It tests a changed premise after absolute heading became directly observable.
